<description>
As discussed in #36403, one of the issues with current rebroadcast behavior is that the rebroadcast begins an unconditional relay of a transaction to peers. While this is broadcast is limited to peers that have not previously been inv'd the transaction, there is still a privacy leak in this double relay of a transaction, especially so for transactions that are still in nodes' mempools.

This PR changes the rebroadcast to only rebroadcast transactions if the transaction was not already present in our mempool. This provides some additional privacy while retaining intended rebroadcast behavior as transactions that have likely fallen out of nodes' mempools are the ones that actually need to be rebroadcast.

The wallet rebroadcast tests are additionally refactored for isolation so that their behaviors can still be tested after this change. Additionally, a test for the loading resubmission was added, as well as a test for the new behavior.
</description>

[2026-11-20] rc:4641111920 inline on test/functional/wallet_resendwallettransactions.py by vasild (member) (edited 2026-11-20):
This assumes that the transaction to be evicted, the one that spends `conflict_utxo`, has a fee rate less than `30`. That is a bit obscure and fragile.

Consider getting the feerate of the transaction to be evicted and using a higher value than that (plus two more asserts - that the to-be-evicted transaction is in the mempool when the function starts and is absent at the end):

```diff
--- i/test/functional/wallet_resendwallettransactions.py
+++ w/test/functional/wallet_resendwallettransactions.py
@@ -9,5 +9,8 @@ from test_framework.blocktools import (
     create_block,
 )
-from test_framework.messages import DEFAULT_MEMPOOL_EXPIRY_HOURS
+from test_framework.messages import (
+    COIN,
+    DEFAULT_MEMPOOL_EXPIRY_HOURS,
+)
 from test_framework.p2p import P2PTxInvStore
 from test_framework.test_framework import BitcoinTestFramework
@@ -45,12 +48,20 @@ class ResendWalletTransactionsTest(BitcoinTestFramework):
     def evict_mempool_transaction(self, conflict_utxo, node, wallet, indep_wallet):
         # Evict a transaction spending conflict_utxo by creating a conflict with it that pays a higher feerate
+        evict_txid = node.gettxspendingprevout([{"txid": conflict_utxo["txid"], "vout": conflict_utxo["vout"]}])[0]["spendingtxid"]
+        assert evict_txid in node.getrawmempool()
+        evict_tx_mempool_entry = node.getmempoolentry(evict_txid)
+        evict_tx_feerate = evict_tx_mempool_entry["fees"]["base"] * COIN / evict_tx_mempool_entry["vsize"]
+
         indep_utxo = indep_wallet.listunspent()[0]
-        psbt = indep_wallet.send(outputs=[{indep_wallet.getnewaddress(): 0.00001}], psbt=True, fee_rate=30, inputs=[conflict_utxo, indep_utxo], solving_data={"descriptors":[conflict_utxo["desc"]]})["psbt"]
+        tx1_feerate = evict_tx_feerate * 2
+        psbt = indep_wallet.send(outputs=[{indep_wallet.getnewaddress(): 0.00001}], psbt=True, fee_rate=tx1_feerate, inputs=[conflict_utxo, indep_utxo], solving_data={"descriptors":[conflict_utxo["desc"]]})["psbt"]
         psbt = wallet.walletprocesspsbt(psbt)["psbt"]
         txid1 = node.sendrawtransaction(node.finalizepsbt(psbt)["hex"])
         # Create a conflict with just indep_utxo to evict the previous transaction so that the original can be rebroadcast
-        r = indep_wallet.send(outputs=[{indep_wallet.getnewaddress(): 0.00001}], fee_rate=60, inputs=[indep_utxo], add_to_wallet=False)
+        tx2_feerate = tx1_feerate * 2
+        r = indep_wallet.send(outputs=[{indep_wallet.getnewaddress(): 0.00001}], fee_rate=tx2_feerate, inputs=[indep_utxo], add_to_wallet=False)
         txid2 = node.sendrawtransaction(r["hex"])
         mempool = node.getrawmempool()
+        assert evict_txid not in node.getrawmempool()
         assert txid1 not in mempool
         assert txid2 in mempool
```

[2026-11-20] r:5988304817 review APPROVED by vasild (member):
ACK 4dbd27f37b52e49a8d392bd2ee6713ae7dcf23df modulo https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/36482#discussion_r4567017959

As for the @murchandamus scenario:

* a transaction is submitted, ends up in the mempool and in the network
* the node is shut down
* fee pressure causes the network to forget about the transaction
* the fee pressure eases on the network
* the node is started
  * at wallet load it will not broadcast the transaction
  * 12-36h later it will not broadcast either because the transaction is in its mempool

https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/36481 would help in that case to manually rebroadcast the transaction.
